Akhilesh Yadav Rules Out Ayodhya Contest After Visiting City

Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav has stated he will not contest elections from Ayodhya, days after visiting the city. This comes after Yadav had previously challenged Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath to contest from Ayodhya. Yadav visited Ayodhya ahead of the Uttar Pradesh polls but did not visit the Ram Mandir.
